description: World - Wind Speed and Power Density GIS Data is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Rachel Fox (World Bank Group). GeoTIFF raster data with worldwide wind speed and wind power density potential. The GIS data stems from the Global Wind Atlas ( This link provides access to the following layers: (1) Wind speed (WS): at 3 heights (50m, 100m, and 200m), stored as separate bands in the raster file (2) Power Density (PD): at 3 ... Coverage: Bermuda, Canada, United States. It has 1 file in GeoTIFF. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Wind. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
